name: ayurvedham
description: Ayurvedham encyclopedia: static site, no runtime dependencies. Dev dependencies are used only for tests.

scripts.test: npm run lint && node tools/validate.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs commerce/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: for f in encyclopedia/js/*.js encyclopedia/js/views/*.js encyclopedia/sw.js tools/*.mjs health/*.mjs clinics/*.mjs agri/*.mjs trade/*.mjs backend/*.mjs commerce/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
